issues.problem: Two inaccuracies in the obstruction text. It cites 'lean-causal at 731ed99', but the pin is ca2ad78. It also says 'lean-causal 731ed99 has no covering-lift of GH or Cauchy surfaces'. That is false at both pins: Causal.Flat.Develop.isCauchySurface_preimage (Cauchy surfaces lift through a flat covering map) and Causal.Flat.Cla.CoverMGH.gh_of_isFiniteCover / isCompact_diamond_of_isFiniteCover (GH lifts along a finite flat cover) exist. They do not apply to an infinite branched cover with T_BTZ, so the obstruction stands. They are, however, the natural templates for the regular part.
issues.fix: Change the pin to ca2ad78. Restate the obstruction as: only unbranched flat coverings (Cauchy lift) and finite flat covers (GH lift) are available upstream, and Cauchy ⇒ GH for topological spacetimes is not built (DEC-78).

issues.problem: The sorry covers the whole diamond-compactness goal. Sub-step (i), that the projection M̃ → M is causal, is in-scaffold work (comparing D-developed charts with M's charts through IsLocallyBTZTilde's lifts) and is not blocked upstream. Proving it as a separate sorry-free lemma would narrow the gap to properness alone. Separately, l.2359's conclusion (future distinguishing) needs only strong causality of M̃ plus Z⁺ plus T2 (isFutureDistinguishing_of_globallyHyperbolic uses only hG.stronglyCausal). A strong-causality transfer M ⇒ M̃ would need (i) and causal connectedness of M̃ (proved), not the properness input. That route could close the row as printed, although GH of M̃ is still owed downstream (theo:globally_hyperbolic_cauchy_complete_cauchy_maximal, 'Since M̃ is globally hyperbolic').
issues.fix: Optional: prove (i) as a separate lemma. Consider stating 'M GH ⇒ M̃ strongly causal' as a route to closing l.2359 without the properness input.
